name: Microsoft Immersive Reader
description: Reading-accessibility tool built into several Microsoft products, offering read-aloud, text spacing and formatting, line focus, translation and related reading controls.
intended_use: Inspect built-in options for changing how on-screen text is displayed or read aloud.
audience_or_context: People who want alternative ways to read digital text, including people with reading differences, attention needs or language-learning needs.
limitations: Features and availability vary by Microsoft product, platform, account and language.
Microsoft's own benefit claims are not treated by ND Oracle as independent evidence of efficacy for a diagnosis.
cost_or_access_notes: Immersive Reader is included in a range of Microsoft products; access to the surrounding product may require a device, account or licence.
conflicts_of_interest: Microsoft develops and promotes the tool; ND Oracle records functions and access rather than adopting Microsoft's outcome claims.

provenance.method: Current first-party identity, access route and stated function checked on 2026-08-28. Listing records what the resource is and how to reach it without adopting provider claims of benefit.
